U.note: Top-down 32x32 grid with stacked heights and only three block types; works but the mobile toolbar is clipped and the empty beige board is bland.

V.note: Textured side-view 32x32 world with a pre-built landscape, ten blocks, undo/reset; attractive though the board runs past the desktop fold.

W.note: Clean empty dark grid with a sidebar palette, autosave and counters; plain visually and the mobile layout pushes the palette below the board.

X.note: Polished isometric 3D 32x32 voxel terrain with place/erase modes, nine blocks and new-terrain; clearly the most impressive and responsive.

Y.note: Flat empty 32x32 grid with eight swatches and save; functional but minimal, with uneven grid lines on mobile.

Z.note: Tidy dark grid with per-block counts, erase tool and undo/clear, but only four block types and the desktop footer is cut off.
